RL = -20·lg|Γ|，越大匹配越好。: RL = -20·lg|Γ|; the larger the value, the better the match.
SOLT（短路/开路/负载/直通）校准消除系统误差，是准确测量的前提。: SOLT (short/open/load/through) calibration removes systematic errors and is the prerequisite for accurate measurement.
史密斯圆图看复阻抗，SWR 圆看驻波，相位看电长度。: The Smith chart shows complex impedance, the SWR circle the standing wave, and the phase the electrical length.
开机预热后用校准件做 SOLT（或电子校准），每次改变频率范围 / 线缆后重新校: After warm-up, perform SOLT (or electronic calibration) with the calibration standards, and recalibrate whenever the frequency range or cables change.
接 S11 测回波损耗与史密斯圆图，找谐振点（SWR 最低）判断谐振频率与带宽。: Connect S11 to measure return loss and the Smith chart; find the resonance (lowest SWR) to judge resonant frequency and bandwidth.
接 S21 看通带插损与带外抑制，S11 看带内回波。: Use S21 to see passband insertion loss and out-of-band rejection, and S11 for in-band return loss.
正向传输系数，反映增益 / 插损。: Forward transmission coefficient, reflecting gain / insertion loss.
测开路 / 短路 S11 或 TDR 模式，定位断点与故障距离。: Measure open / short S11 or use TDR mode to locate breaks and the distance to a fault.
矢量网络分析仪，测量器件在扫频范围内的复散射参数（S 参数）与复阻抗。: A vector network analyser measures a device's complex scattering parameters (S-parameters) and complex impedance across a swept frequency range.
确认谐振频率与带宽，指导修剪: Confirm the resonant frequency and bandwidth, and guide trimming
输入反射系数，反映端口匹配程度（回波损耗）。: Input reflection coefficient, reflecting how well the port is matched (return loss).
验证通带与带外抑制: Verify the passband and out-of-band rejection
验证阻抗变换与平衡性能: Verify the impedance transformation and balance performance
